```text
TEMPLATE_ARTIFACT_ACTIVE
TEMPLATE_ARTIFACT_NON_ACTIVE
TEMPLATE_ARTIFACT_STALE
TEMPLATE_KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE
TEMPLATE_GOAL_VERSION_STALE

```

```text
TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS_COMPLETE
TEMPLATE_PARAMETER_MISSING
TEMPLATE_PARAMETER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
TEMPLATE_ADAPTATION_APPLIED
TEMPLATE_ADAPTATION_REJECTED
```

```text
TEMPLATE_DAG_VALID
TEMPLATE_DAG_INVALID
TEMPLATE_CRITERIA_COVERED
```

## 正式 Handoff

```text
TEMPLATE_VALIDATOR_PASSED
TEMPLATE_VALIDATOR_REJECTED
TEMPLATE_PLANNING_SESSION_CREATED
TEMPLATE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
TEMPLATE_GOAL_LOCK_ACQUIRED
TEMPLATE_GOAL_LOCK_FAILED
TEMPLATE_FORMAL_PLAN_COMMITTED
TEMPLATE_FORMAL_HANDOFF_FALLBACK
TEMPLATE_FORMAL_HANDOFF_FAILED
```

Reason Code 必须稳定、可测试、可审计，不包含私有思维链。
